outcome: Procedure-related complications (bradycardia, intraperitoneal spill, PPROM, IUD)
Postnatal outcomes (intensive phototherapy, post-delivery transfusion, late neonatal anemia)
cohort: The study included 33 anemic fetuses who underwent a total of 59 intrauterine transfusions at a single tertiary care center.
finding: Early gestational age at transfusion and the presence of hydrops significantly increased procedure-related adverse events.
followup_time: Postnatal outcomes were recorded, including the occurrence of late neonatal anemia, but a specific duration is not mentioned.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at transfusion was 26 weeks for complicated procedures and 29.8 weeks for uneventful procedures; median age of delivery after IUT was 35 weeks.
